GURUNATH BAGWE
Thane West - 400601
Phone: +91-8879255398
Email: imgurubagwe@gmail.com

PROFESSIONAL SUMMARY
Procurement professional with 12+ years of experience in strategic sourcing, vendor management, and contract negotiations. Expertise in cost optimization, supplier management, risk mitigation, and compliance. Proven track record of streamlining procurement processes, strengthening supplier relationships, and driving operational efficiency.
CORE COMPETENCIES 
· Procurement & Sourcing – Strategic Sourcing, Cost Negotiation, Purchase-to-Pay Process
· Contract Management – SOW, MPA, NDA, Vendor Compliance, Risk Management
· Vendor & Inventory Management – Vendor Development, Inventory Planning, Lead Time Management
· Technology – SAP Business One, D-365, CLM Tool, ERP, MS Excel, Tally


PROFESSIONAL EXPERIENCE
Teleperformance Global Business Pvt Ltd | June 2022 – Present
Manager – Procurement
Industry: Service Industry
· Managing PAN India procurement operations for multiple business locations, ensuring timely availability of goods and services. 
· Handling strategic sourcing activities, vendor selection, RFQ/RFP processes, comparative analysis, and final negotiations. 
· Negotiating annual rate contracts and long-term agreements to optimize procurement costs and improve service levels. 
· Administering the complete contract lifecycle including drafting, reviewing, and managing MPA, SOW, NDA, addendums, and vendor agreements. 
· Conducting reverse auctions and implementing e-procurement practices to enhance supplier competitiveness and cost efficiency. 
· Coordinating with cross-functional teams including Operations, Finance, Admin, and Legal for procurement related requirements. 
· Ensuring adherence to procurement policies, compliance requirements, audit controls, and risk management processes. 
· Managing contract renewals, vendor onboarding, documentation, and procurement MIS reporting. 
· Driving process improvements and automation initiatives to enhance operational efficiency and procurement effectiveness.

R-Pac India Pvt Ltd | May 2017 – May 2022
Assistant Manager – Procurement/Sourcing
Industry: Printing and Packaging Industry
· Managed end-to-end procurement activities for direct and indirect materials across manufacturing operations. 
· Sourced raw materials, packaging materials, consumables, and operational supplies while ensuring quality and cost efficiency. 
· Identified, evaluated, and developed new vendors to improve sourcing capability and reduce procurement costs. 
· Conducted price negotiations, vendor evaluations, and cost comparisons to achieve better commercial terms. 
· Coordinated with production, stores, Product Development and planning teams to ensure uninterrupted material availability. 
· Managed inventory planning and forecasting to maintain optimum stock levels and reduce excess inventory. 
· Led vendor audits and compliance audits including ISO 9001:2015, and internal quality assessments. 
· Maintained procurement documentation, vendor records, and purchase reports in ERP systems. 
· Ensured timely delivery of materials and resolved supplier-related issues to avoid production disruptions. 
· Monitoring supplier performance based on quality, delivery timelines, pricing, and compliance standards. 


R & R Salons Pvt Ltd (YLG Salon) | May 2013 – Jan 2014
Executive – Purchase & Inventory
Industry: Service Industry
· Managed procurement of cosmetic products, salon equipment, machinery, and consumables for salon operations. 
· Coordinated with vendors for quotation requests, order placement, and timely deliveries. 
· Monitored inventory levels and ensured availability of products across salon locations. 
· Negotiated pricing and commercial terms with suppliers to achieve cost savings. 
· Maintained vendor relationships and resolved supply-related issues effectively. 
· Prepared purchase orders, inventory reports, and procurement-related documentation. 
· Coordinated with operations teams to understand product requirements and procurement priorities.

Economode Food Equipment (I) Pvt Ltd | May 2012 – May 2013
Executive – Purchase
Industry: Manufacturing
· Procured raw materials including SS sheets, pipes, motors, spare parts, and fabrication-related items. 
· Obtained quotations from vendors, conducted comparative analysis, and finalized suppliers based on quality and pricing. 
· Coordinated with production and engineering teams to ensure timely material procurement as per project schedules. 
· Followed up with suppliers to ensure on-time delivery and material quality compliance. 
· Maintained purchase records, vendor databases, and procurement documentation. 
· Assisted in inventory monitoring and material planning activities. 
· Supported cost reduction initiatives through effective negotiations and alternate vendor sourcing.



Aaryan Engineering Pvt Ltd | Sept 2009 – Jan 2012
Officer – Purchase
Industry: Manufacturing
· Handled procurement of engineering materials, consumables, tools, and operational supplies. 
· Identified vendors, obtained quotations, and processed purchase orders as per business requirements. 
· Coordinated with stores and production departments to monitor material requirements and stock availability. 
· Ensured procurement of quality materials at competitive prices within defined timelines. 
· Maintained procurement records, supplier details, and order tracking reports.

TECHNICAL SKILLS
· ERP Systems: SAP Business One, Microsoft D-365, Tally ERP, Vendor Portal, CLM Tool.
· Data Analysis: MS Excel (Pivot Tables, VLOOKUP)
· Procurement & Audits: e-Procurement, Compliance Audits, Vendor Evaluation

EDUCATION
Bachelor of Commerce (B. Com) – Mumbai University (2011-2012)
Higher Secondary Certificate (HSC) – R.A.D.A.V. College, Bhandup, Mumbai (2008-2009)
Secondary School Certificate (SSC) – Y.C.S. Vidyamandir, Bhandup, Mumbai (2006-2007)

ADDITIONAL INFORMATION
· Languages Known: English, Marathi, Hindi
· Interests: Table Tennis, Cricket, Shopping.
